policy: The planned 100-position, 400-critique Hard Set must not enter bulk annotation merely because its source quotas are approved.

pilot_evidence: A frozen pilot result report contains actual rating time, agreement, attrition, disagreement, adjudication, and operational measurements.
At least one senior methodological adviser has reviewed the pilot summary.
The project owner records whether and how the rubric, assignment system, and adjudication protocol must change.

external_funding_path: Awarded or otherwise legally available funds are documented; pending applications and verbal interest do not count.
The funded budget covers the planned 800 blind initial ratings, pilot-derived re-rating and adjudication demand, operations, payment administration, and required legal or tax work.
The cost model uses observed pilot workload and variance rather than the LMCA 5–15 minute estimate alone.
No funding is double-counted across overlapping grants or the Pilot 01 USD 500 ceiling.
volunteer_capacity_path: Qualified raters provide written, non-ambiguous commitments whose accepted capacities sum to at least 800 blind initial rating units during the proposed window.
Qualified adjudicators provide written commitments covering the pilot-derived expected adjudication and final-signoff workload.
At least two qualified replacement raters or equivalent documented replacement capacity are available.
Expressions of interest, referrals, and uncalibrated applicants do not count as committed capacity.
The operations owner verifies that commitments remain feasible after conflicts, exposure exclusions, and assignment balancing.

item_readiness: The exact 50 LMCA, 20 public-synthetic, and 30 protected position records pass their source-specific promotion gates.
The exact 400 critiques, provenance records, exposure classes, and split assignments are frozen.
Protected items remain absent from public manifests and public application materials.
necessary_conditions.owner_authorization: After all preceding conditions are evidenced, Ellen Sun must explicitly approve expansion and sign a new readiness record.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not treat the USD 500 Pilot 01 budget as funding for the 400-critique programme.
Do not infer volunteer capacity from prestige, affiliation, prior LMCA work, or silence after outreach.
Do not count senior methodological advisers as bulk raters unless they separately accept and pass the applicable bulk-rater requirements.
Do not publish or advertise a full-set start date before the expansion and readiness gates pass.
Do not represent the Hard Set as completed, expert validated, hidden, or benchmark ready before the corresponding evidence exists.
gate_record_requirements: Pilot result report identifier and checksum.
Funding award documentation or deidentified signed-capacity ledger.
